audits.message: Independently audit all twelve anonymous texts/readings in {WORKSPACE}/packets/audit_N1.json against only the locked source body {WORKSPACE}/inputs/N1.txt. No PDFs, full extraction, metadata, guides, mappings, preferences, other outputs/history, browsing or agents. For the critical question (the identical task objective supplied to both writers), classify support in the actual prose as supported/missing/contradicted/uncertain. Do not require source wording or every detail; if a legitimate alternative answers the bounded objective, credit it. Fidelity pass/concern/fail remains separate from missing explanation. Source/table/equation ambiguity is uncertain, not invented numerical error. Reader support is text_grounded/inferred/wrong/unanswered/ambiguous; a correct source fact must not fill a prose gap. Locate source/prose/reading witnesses in <=110words/text. Save one untouched response via apply_patch to {WORKSPACE}/raw/audit_N1_1.json schema {"audits":[{"id":"text id","fidelity":"pass|concern|fail","critical_support":"supported|missing|contradicted|uncertain","reader_support":"text_grounded|inferred|wrong|unanswered|ambiguous","reason":"located explanation"}]}. No raw repair, source normalization or quality retry. Final only path and operational problems.
